actions.observed: ASCII double quote inserts an empty pair with caret inside; Backspace deletes both; retyping creates the pair again.
A separate native text paste inserts 中文😀 between the quotes. Typing the ending quote advances over the existing closer without changing the literal.
if true {} splits into a two-tab body line and a one-tab closer. One Cmd+Z restores the pair, one Cmd+Shift+Z restores the complete split/indent.
The deliberately over-indented case 1 receives a colon and aligns to one tab; Enter creates a two-tab body line.
consume() splits into a two-tab argument line with one-tab closing parenthesis.
Typing } before an existing over-indented closer skips it and aligns that closing-only line to one tab.
The existing quote after 界 is skipped. The raw backtick after C:\ is skipped even though the preceding character is a backslash. Literal content is unchanged.
Enter after 中文😀 splits // Native typing 中文😀 payload into two line comments; the second line is // payload. Unicode is preserved.
Enter after pay on a four-space-indented payload line produces pay\nload with caret column 1. One Undo restores the exact original raw value.

Other Settings > Go initially shows the unchecked Indent on Enter in raw strings checkbox. Checking and accepting it makes the same split produce pay\n    load, caret column 5. One Undo restores the original raw value.

inferences: The trace corroborates the parent agent native typing observations: quote pair inserts are aggregated into one version; Backspace deletes both quotes; Chinese text plus a supplementary emoji reaches gopls without invalid UTF-16 ranges.
The comment split at version 16 uses a UTF-16 character offset after Chinese/emoji content. Replay reproduces intact Unicode code points and the continued // prefix.
Versions 17 and 19 show the raw string Enter policy changing from newline-only to newline plus four spaces. Versions 18 and 20 restore the same original raw string.
There is one wrapper identity and one initialize request through the observed raw-string policy changes; no gopls restart or didChangeConfiguration appears in this captured prefix.

The initial missing-case-colon syntax diagnostic clears at version 12. Subsequent full diagnostic publications contain only warnings, not severity-1 syntax/type errors. A transient curly quotation mark diagnostic at version 3 is also retained in the evidence rather than omitted.

Both Shared Find Usages requests return the same four wire locations (one declaration and three calls across the two workspace modules). The parent-reported Current File versus Project Files UI counts corroborate client-side search-scope filtering. The Find Usages window (records 579–587) contains two definition requests and no typeDefinition/implementation request; later explicit LSP navigation is classified separately.

After the root-observed clean native quit, all seven supplied owned PIDs are absent and the project settings XML still records indentRawStringsOnEnter=true. This proves saved state survived shutdown, not that reopening has been tested.

The complete final replay validates all UTF-16 edit boundaries/range lengths and exactly matches all five opened documents on disk in UTF-8 and UTF-16LE content hashes. Editor version 21 only deletes three two-tab trailing-whitespace ranges at save time.
limitations: Reopening the product and checking the persisted raw-string setting through native UI has not been tested.

The protocol cannot independently prove every physical keystroke, visual caret/selection, popup or action origin. Parent native UI evidence remains necessary, especially for overtype without document mutation.
The standard Go To Implementation and Type Declaration native actions remain a confirmed gap, even though explicit LSP navigation works.
The final trace has four didClose events for five opened files and no shutdown/exit handshake; PID termination is separately observed. No stronger protocol shutdown claim is made.
No claim of exact proprietary GoLand implementation or complete IDE feature parity is made.
